data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to turn a device into a BLE peripheral and advertise GATT services.
data.what_it_does: Provides an OS‑independent API to create a BLE GATT server, add services/characteristics, and start/stop advertising. Includes callbacks for connection, read/write requests, and subscription changes across Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows.
use_when: you need to expose custom BLE services from a Flutter app
testing or prototyping BLE servers on multiple platforms
avoid_when: you only need BLE central (client) functionality
targeting Linux or platforms not listed
strengths: rich callback system for read/write/connection events
weaknesses: requires native permission setup and may crash on some edge cases
data.setup_notes: Add Bluetooth permissions to AndroidManifest (BLUETOOTH, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, etc.) and NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription to iOS/macOS Info.plist; request runtime permissions (e.g., via permission_handler).
